Now implementing. First the parser refactor:

Implementation complete. All checks green.

## Files

**New**
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/wire/fragment.rs` — `from_fragment_json(input, schema, options) -> Result<Fragment, ParseError>` decoding `{"blocks":[...]}`. Rejects non-object root (`fragment_not_object`), missing `blocks` (`missing_blocks`), non-array `blocks` (`blocks_not_array`), and `Doc::new` limit violations (`limit`). Blocks are decoded through the existing document decoder path and validated as the content of an attribute-less doc, so accepted nodes equal the schema's document content model; error paths are stable block-relative indices (`0`, `0.2.1`). An empty `blocks` array decodes to `Fragment::default()` (explicitly documented; useful because `Fragment` has an empty state while a doc content model requires `block+`). Also adds canonical writer methods `Fragment::to_json_into(schema, out)` and `Fragment::to_json_string(schema)` producing `{"blocks":[...]}`.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/fragment_json.rs` — 11 tests: valid fragment + canonical write, decode/write round-trip, empty fragment, missing `blocks`, non-array `blocks`, non-object root, unknown node (path asserted), unknown mark, unknown attr (path asserted), inline atom at block position (`I1`), missing text.

**Modified (wire only)**
- `src/wire/parser.rs` — extracted `decode_blocks(values, schema, options)` and `check_doc(doc, schema, offset)` from `decode_doc` so fragments reuse the exact same block decoding/validation path without re-parsing or cloning the JSON tree. `decode_doc` behavior is unchanged (validation fallback offset still 0).
- `src/wire/writer.rs` — added `pub(super) fn write_fragment_into` reusing `write_block`.
- `src/wire/mod.rs` — `mod fragment;` and `pub use fragment::from_fragment_json;`.

No changes outside `src/wire` and `tests`. (Other modified files in `git status` belong to concurrent work, not this task.)

## Verification
- `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --locked --all-targets`: clean, no warnings.
- `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked`: 62 passed, 0 failed.
- `rustfmt --check` on all touched files: clean.

## Omitted
None of this ticket's sub-features are omitted. The optional canonical fragment writer was implemented. Note the fragment decoder enforces the schema's document content model for top-level blocks (e.g. a bare top-level `image` yields invariant `I1`); this follows the "wrap blocks as a document" design.
